question:
The bar graph given below shows the population of two states P and Q in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad73017f742763b2e62d82192c2150d62305bbcc64f5d5ab5fa101ac0e47a8c.png] 

The population of P in year M and N together is how much percent less than the population of Q in year K and L together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The population of P in years M and N together:

M + N = 300 + 200 = 500

The population of Q in years K and L together

K + L = 500 + 350 = 850

According to the question:

(850 - 500)/850 × 100

(350)/850 × 100

41.17%

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
